Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly conflated “The Girl in White” with the different film “Lady in White” (1988) and introduced an irrelevant constraint to focus only on 1930s films. This disambiguation error led them to skip retrieving the correct film’s director (The Girl in White, 1952, directed by John Sturges, born 1910) and to avoid properly comparing both directors’ birth years. While the final answer happened to be correct, this was the first substantive error in the reasoning.
